message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors.

First: class extends BaseJsonValidator, but test class should not extend it. It should be a test class, not a validator. Should not extend BaseJsonValidator. Remove extends BaseJsonValidator and remove overridden methods.

Also need to import static assertions from JUnit: import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; So assertNotNull, assertTrue, assertEquals available.

Also need to adjust validator initialization: PrefixItemsValidator constructor signature? Likely PrefixItemsValidator(String schemaPath, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonSchema parentSchema, ValidationContext validationContext). The test used nulls for parentSchema and validationContext. That's fine. But need to import ValidationContext class.

Also need to adjust tupleSchema field: In PrefixItemsValidator class there is a private List<JsonSchema> tupleSchema; we need to set via reflection. Already using setField.

But test class currently defines its own tupleSchema field (private final List<JsonSchema> tupleSchema;) which is unrelated. Should remove that field and getTupleSchema method. Actually test class doesn't need those. Remove them.

Also the overridden walk and validate methods should be removed.

Thus final test class will be a plain class with @Test methods.

Also need import ExecutionContext, ValidationMessage, PrefixItemsValidator, ApplyDefaultsStrategy, etc.

Add import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

Also need to import com.networknt.schema.ValidationContext; Already there.

Also need to import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema; for reflection maybe not needed.

Now compile.
